        if line.startswith('{'):
            # possible function body start; gather header from previous lines
            j = i - 1
            header = []
            while j >= 0:

                        k -= 1
                    break

            depth = 0
            end = None
            for k in range(i, n):
                for ch in lines[k]:

                    elif ch == '}': depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
